findings.text: follow-on: the already-cleared early return sits after the probe-registry lookup at :1348, so a cleared blocker whose probe id left the registry raises "unknown probe id" instead of reporting its recorded clear; the branch is never exercised by the tests.

item_verdicts.diff: read the single commit c8ab8bda8 against base 060d94f50 commit by commit; four files changed, +315/-0, adding the probe registry, the evaluation command and the composed-state cleared filter.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks a temporary-repository test to show arrival clears, absence holds and an unknown id is reported; tests/test_held_blocker_probe.py:26 exercises all three against a tmp_path docs tree.
item_verdicts.goal: the selected node goal is to let a held blocker name a probe id resolving to a registered Python callable and clear it with the probe id and finding as the reason; reckon/held_probes.py:38 registers path-exists in PROBES and reckon/project_state.py:1338 resolves it and writes the cleared_reason at :1374.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records base 535 passed and head 537 passed with 0 added failures, a negative control reddening both new tests at base, and a focused 2-passed run.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed manifest declares reckon/project_state.py, reckon/held_probes.py, reckon/cli.py and tests/test_held_blocker_probe.py; every path in the c8ab8bda8 diff lies inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_held_blocker_probe.py:26 reddens at base with evaluate_held_blocker absent and asserts stored version 1->2 and cleared_reason against the resource the code had to write; the already-cleared early return at reckon/project_state.py:1350 is left untested.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_held_blocker_probe.py:26 asserts the three done_when cases and both gate arms are recorded at EXIT=0 in baseline-suite.log and after-suite.log.
justifications.fit: reckon/held_probes.py:38 uses a module-level registry and reckon/project_state.py:1377 stamps cleared_at with datetime.now(UTC), matching the surrounding idiom.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/project_state.py:1350-1374 clears the blocker and records reason "probe path-exists: <finding>", naming the probe id and its finding as the goal states.
justifications.scope_discipline: every file in the c8ab8bda8 diff is a declared write path and the change carries nothing the goal does not imply.
